requirements.text: Visited links shall be recorded to the Global History.
The correct link shall be recorded to the Global History after a server redirect.
Clicking on a history link shall cause it to be launched in a browser window.
A History entry shall be deleted.
Multiple History entries shall be deleted and no longer be displayed.
History items shall be grouped by Day / Site / None.
History shall be sorted and reverse-sorted per column.
History columns shall be resizable to show/hide more of entries.
History colmns shall be shown and hidden.
Recently visited sites shall be re-visited via Back and Forward button dropdown menu.
A new, empty session history file shall be created for a new browser window or a restart.

generated_cases.title: Record Visited Link to Global History
generated_cases.description: Verify that visiting a standard web link successfully records the link to the Global History.

generated_cases.title: Record Correct Link After Server Redirect
generated_cases.description: Verify that when a server redirect occurs, the final target link is correctly recorded in the Global History instead of the initial redirect URL.

generated_cases.title: Launch History Link in Browser Window
generated_cases.description: Verify that clicking on an existing link within the Global History causes it to be successfully launched in a browser window.

generated_cases.title: Delete Single History Entry
generated_cases.description: Verify that a single selected History entry can be deleted successfully.

generated_cases.title: Delete Multiple History Entries
generated_cases.description: Verify that multiple selected History entries can be deleted simultaneously and are no longer displayed in the history view.

generated_cases.title: Clear Global History
generated_cases.description: Verify that the entire Global History can be cleared completely.

generated_cases.title: Group History Items by Day
generated_cases.description: Verify that history items can be successfully grouped by Day.

generated_cases.title: Group History Items by Site
generated_cases.description: Verify that history items can be successfully grouped by Site.

generated_cases.title: Group History Items by None
generated_cases.description: Verify that history items can be displayed without any grouping (None).

generated_cases.title: Sort History Columns Normal and Reverse
generated_cases.description: Verify that history items can be sorted and reverse-sorted per column.

generated_cases.title: Resize History Columns
generated_cases.description: Verify that history columns can be resized to show or hide more of the entries.

generated_cases.title: Show and Hide History Columns
generated_cases.description: Verify that individual history columns can be explicitly shown and hidden.

generated_cases.title: Re-visit Sites via Back and Forward Dropdown Menu
generated_cases.description: Verify that recently visited sites can be re-visited by using the Back and Forward button dropdown menus.

generated_cases.title: Create New Empty Session History File for New Window or Restart
generated_cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is created when opening a new browser window or performing a browser restart.

generated_cases.title: Record Visited Link to Global History
generated_cases.description: Transition from unvisited state to recorded history state when a link is visited.

generated_cases.title: Record Redirected Link to Global History
generated_cases.description: Transition to record the correct final link after a server redirect occurs.

generated_cases.title: Launch History Link in Browser Window
generated_cases.description: Transition from history list state to active browser window state by clicking a history link.

generated_cases.title: Delete Single History Entry
generated_cases.description: Transition from existing history entry state to deleted state.

generated_cases.title: Delete Multiple History Entries
generated_cases.description: Transition from multiple history entries state to removed state where they are no longer displayed.

generated_cases.title: Clear Global History
generated_cases.description: Transition from populated global history state to completely cleared history state.

generated_cases.title: Group History Items
generated_cases.description: Transition history items display state into grouped configurations by Day, Site, or None.

generated_cases.title: Sort and Reverse-Sort History Columns
generated_cases.description: Transition history list sorting state between normal and reverse-sort per column.

generated_cases.title: Resize History Columns
generated_cases.description: Transition history column width state to show or hide more entry details.

generated_cases.title: Show and Hide History Columns
generated_cases.description: Transition history column visibility state between shown and hidden.

generated_cases.title: Re-visit Sites via Back and Forward Dropdown Menu
generated_cases.description: Transition browser navigation state by re-visiting recently visited sites via the Back and Forward button dropdown menu.

generated_cases.title: Create New Session History File
generated_cases.description: Transition to a new, empty session history file state upon opening a new browser window or performing a restart.

generated_cases.title: Record visited links and server redirects in Global History
generated_cases.description: Verify that normal visited links and redirected links are correctly recorded in the Global History.

generated_cases.title: Session initialization and re-visiting via navigation dropdowns
generated_cases.description: Verify that a new session history file is created upon browser restart and recent sites can be re-visited using Back and Forward dropdown menus.

generated_cases.title: History organization by grouping, sorting, and column management
generated_cases.description: Verify that history items can be grouped, sorted/reverse-sorted per column, and that history columns can be resized, shown, and hidden.

generated_cases.title: Interacting with and deleting history entries
generated_cases.description: Verify that clicking a history link launches it in a browser window, single and multiple history entries can be deleted, and the global history can be cleared entirely.

generated_cases.title: Recording Redirect Links Incorrectly
generated_cases.description: Attempt to verify whether a server redirect incorrectly logs the intermediate redirect URL instead of the final target link into the Global History.

generated_cases.title: Corrupted Session History on Restart
generated_cases.description: Test the creation of a new session history file when restarting the browser with locked or corrupted profile file permissions to ensure a valid empty file is created.

generated_cases.title: Deleting Non-Existent or Already Deleted History Entries
generated_cases.description: Attempt to delete a single history entry and multiple history entries that have already been removed or corrupted in the database to verify error handling and display synchronization.

generated_cases.title: Clearing Partially Locked Global History
generated_cases.description: Trigger the Global History clear operation while a history database lock or write error is artificially introduced to verify robust failure handling.

generated_cases.title: Invalid Column Grouping and Sorting States
generated_cases.description: Apply malformed or unsupported grouping parameters (Day/Site/None) and extreme column sizing values to verify that history sorting and column visibility do not break the UI.

generated_cases.title: Dropdown Menu Navigation with Empty History
generated_cases.description: Attempt to access the Back and Forward button dropdown menus for recently visited sites when the session history is completely empty or corrupted.

generated_cases.title: Launching Broken or Malformed History Links
generated_cases.description: Click on a history link that points to an invalid protocol or malformed URI to test browser window launching error resilience.

reference_cases.title: TC-073
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. Observe the contents of the Global History Window.
3. Quit and restart the browser.
4. Select Go|History.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. If you've observed the initial conditions, the History window should be non-empty upon first observation.
2. After restart, the History window should still be non-empty.

reference_cases.description:

1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

reference_cases.title: TC-076
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. Select (highlight) a history entry, press the delete key, OR
3. Select (highlight) a history entry, Select Edit|Delete.
4. Restart the browser.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. After step(3) the title of and link to the history entry should now be removed from the history window.
2. After step(4) it should still be gone.

reference_cases.title: TC-077
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. Select any history entry. Shift+click or drag to select more (at least 3).
3. Select Edit|Delete.
4. Restart the browser. Select Go|History

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. After step(3) the titles and links to the history entries should now be removed from the history window.
2. After step(4) they should still be gone.

reference_cases.title: TC-078
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. Observe the contents of the Global History Window.
3. Select Edit|Preferences (from a navigator window)
4. Browse to the Navigator|History Panel.
5. Under "Browsing History" click the "Clear History" button.
6. Return to observe the contents of the Global History Window.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. If you've observed the initial conditions, the History window should be non-empty upon first observation.
2. After pressing the button, the history window should be empty of individual history items.

reference_cases.title: TC-079
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. In the Global History window, select View|Group By|Day.
3. In the Global History window, select View|Group By|Site.
4. In the Global History window, select View|Group By|None.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. After Step(2), history entries should appear grouped into folders labeled "Today", "Yesterday", "2 days ago", ... ,"6 days ago", and "Older than 6 days".
2. After Step(3), the history items should appear grouped by domain name (no folders).
3. After Sep (4), the history items should appear

reference_cases.title: TC-080
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
Select Go|History. This is most easily tested by using the View|Group By|None setting but not strictly necessary.
1. Click on the "Title" column once.
2. Click on the "Title" column a second time.
3. Click on the "Title" column a third time.
4. Click on the "Location" column once, and a second time.
5. Click on the "Last Visited" column once, and a second time.

EXPECTED RESULTS
By step:
1. The bookmarks should sort into alphabetical order, by Title.
2. The bookmarks should sort into reverse-alphabetical order, by Title.
3. The bookmarks should sort into "natural" order (the way they were originally sorted).
4. The bookmarks should sort into order by Location and then the reverse of that order.
5. The bookmarks should sort into order by Last Visited and then the reverse of that order.

reference_cases.title: TC-081
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. Mouseover the separator between the "Name" and "URL" columns.
3. Click and drag that separator to the left and right.
4. Repeat this with each of the other column separators.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. In step(2) the mouse pointer should change to a double-arrowed icon(platform specific or XP?).
2. In step(3) the column sizes on either side of the separator should shrink and grow as you drag. The content of the column should move with the column header. Column content that is obscured should be replaced by the ellipsis(?).

reference_cases.title: TC-082
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. Click the icon on the far right of the column headers.
3. Uncheck two of the items (columns).
4. Recheck an item.
5. Quit and restart the application.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. Step(2) a popup menu should appear listing all of the column headers as menuitems.
2. Step(3), they should all be checked by default and unchecking should cause that column to disappear from the manage bookmarks window.
3. Step(4), the columns should reappear upon rechecking its name on the list.
4. Step(5) the columns should appear just as the did after step(4).

reference_cases.title: TC-083
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. Your session history needs to be empty for this test so restart the browser or open a new window. To check, the Back/Forward buttons should be inactive and the dropdowns should not appear at all when the session history is empty.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Follow this Netscape link.
2. Follow this Netscape People link.
3. Wait for the redirect (15sec).
4. Follow this Mozilla QA link.
5. Follow this Mozilla link.
6. From the "Back" button dropdown select the 4th item from the top "Netscape.com".
7. From the "Forward" button dropdown select the 3rd item from the top "Mozilla QA Home Page"

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. For Step(6), the dropdown menu should be apparent and active, the 4th item should be "Netscape.com", the page title, and selecting it should actually load that page
2. For Step(7), the dropdown menu should be apparent and active, the 3rd item should be "Mozilla QA Home Page", the page title, and selecting it should actually load that page.

reference_cases.title: TC-084
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select File|New Navigator Window.
2. Select the Go menu.
3. Quit and restart the browser.
4. Select the Go menu.

EXPECTED RESULTS
After steps(2) and (4) the browser go meu should be "empty" ie only Back, Forward, and Home should be listed.

technique_rationales.equivalence_partitioning: Cover partitioning of history entries for single vs multiple deletions, and different grouping options like Day, Site, or None.
technique_rationales.state_transition: Cover states and transitions such as recording visited links, handling server redirects, clearing global history, and creating a new session history file.
technique_rationales.use_case: Cover end-to-end user workflows such as navigating history via Back and Forward dropdown menus and clicking history links to launch them.
technique_rationales.error_guessing: Explore plausible failure conditions such as sorting, resizing columns, and handling hidden/shown columns incorrectly.
